No incompatible or dangling events are present.

criteria.rationale: Chronology is preserved with clear time segments (0-4s, 4-7.5s, 7.5-11s, 11-15s). State transitions are plausible and sequential. non_diegetic_music: An upbeat, steady percussion-driven track at a moderate tempo with light rhythmic accents matching the exercise beats

criteria.rationale: Temporal and semantic alignment is maintained: rhythmic pulses match music accents, synchronized breathing and shuffling footsteps align with movement beats. Lip-sync is not applicable (no dialogue). Effects (footsteps, fabric rustle) are temporally aligned with actions. No misaligned events.

summary: The enhanced prompt maintains strong internal consistency with the original instruction, preserving subject identity, action progression, chronology, spatial logic, and sensory alignment. Minor discrepancies exist in the final pose description and slight variation in arm positioning during dispersion, but these do not materially alter the core intent or sequence. The prompt successfully integrates all requested elements into a coherent, continuous performance with consistent visual and kinetic logic.
